Synthetic contract fixtures; no captured credentials, accounts or transcripts.

Usage/profile shapes follow CodexBar 0.81.0's MIT-licensed OAuth parser contract
(ee890b5f392e70d6e20162d3e95cf9f1be265b60). All identities and numbers are invented.
The prepaid amount/currency shape follows its web prepaid parser; the OAuth route
is an owner-requested beta contract, not a verified first-party public API.
Only explicit USD minor units are supported for the prepaid balance.
